Vocabulary. Listen and read.

lines.t: boring (adj.)  not interesting or exciting.  Ex. The film is boring.
busy (adj.)  Having many things to do.  Ex. I'm busy today.
fast (adj.)  Moving quickly.  Ex. The race car goes so fast.
awake (adj.)  not sleeping.  Ex. The birds are awake and singing.
asleep (adj.)  Sleeping.  Ex. I was so tired, I fell asleep right away.

sets.task: Vocabulary. Listen and read.

lines.t: fun (adj.)  Something enjoyable or that makes you happy.  Ex. This game is really fun!
lazy (adj.)  Not wanting to work or do things.  Ex. Don't be lazy, help me clean up!
slow (adj.)  not quickly.  Ex. A snail is a very slow animal.
loud (adj.)  strong and noisy.  Ex. The thunder was very loud.
quiet (adj.)  peaceful.  Ex. Please be quiet in the library.

items.text: Birds and Bears. Look at this amazing bird! This bird can fly very [[fast]]. It is always [[awake]] in the morning and sings songs. Birds like to fly high in the sky and build nests. It's [[fun]] to watch them. Now look at the big, brown bear. The bear is very [[lazy]]. It likes to sleep a lot, especially in winter. When a bear growls, its sound can be very [[loud]].
